title: 1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_1LE--- after 10^128 events: two chain laws around a new turning cell
text: At about 10128 events the head of 1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_1LE--- starts turning back 17 cells into the chain. Around the new cell the tape is two chains: base-3 words of N on the left, parted by 1010, where each wrap sends 2, and the binary chain on the right, where each wrap sends 3. The law holds on 226,899 consecutive pairs of visits, and a simulator that jumps by it covers about 10127 more visits with no halt, until a carry leaves the right chain and the turning cell moves again.
